item.title: 18-year-old in life-threatening condition after semi crash
item.description: The 18-year-old was at first treated at the scene before being taken to a nearby hospital for life-threatening injuries. The driver of the semi was not injured.

item.title: Snow showers early Sunday
item.description: A clipper system moves in and brings light snow showers early Sunday morning before sunrise. Temperatures will reach the upper teens by Sunday morning. This band will bring light accumulations of a dusting to around an 1". Our latest Futurecast model does indicate accumulations around an 1", with heavier snowfall totals southwest of Fort Wayne.
